<fo:root xmlns:fo="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Format"> <fo:layout-master-set> <fo:simple-page-master master-name="receipt" page-width="${paperWidth}" page-height="297mm" margin-top="3mm" margin-bottom="3mm" margin-left="3mm" margin-right="3mm"> <fo:region-body/> </fo:simple-page-master> </fo:layout-master-set>
<fo:page-sequence master-reference="receipt"> <fo:flow flow-name="xsl-region-body" color="#000" font-weight="${(receiptOptions.density == 'light')?then('normal',(receiptOptions.density == 'dark')?then('bold','600'))}"> <#if pdfUnsupported> <fo:block font-size="10pt" font-weight="bold">Unicode receipt printing</fo:block> <fo:block font-size="9pt" space-before="3mm">This PDF renderer has Latin fonts only. To preserve all receipt characters, print this saved bill from POS History using the browser or QZ printer driver with matching fonts. No bill data has been changed.</fo:block> <#else> <#if receiptOptions.openingPreset != 'none' && receiptOptions.openingMessage?has_content> <fo:block text-align="${receiptOptions.greetingAlign}" color="${receiptTones.greeting}" font-weight="${receiptOptions.greetingBold?then('bold','normal')}" font-size="${(receiptOptions.greetingSize=='small')?then('7pt',(receiptOptions.greetingSize=='large')?then('12pt','9pt'))}" linefeed-treatment="preserve">${receiptOptions.openingMessage?xml}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Store Name --> <fo:block font-size="12pt" font-weight="${receiptOptions.companyBold?then('bold','normal')}" color="${receiptTones.company}" text-align="center" space-after="0.5mm">${storeName?xml}</fo:block>
<#-- Store Address --> <#if storeAddr?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="${receiptTones.company}">${storeAddr?xml}</fo:block> </#if> <#if storePhone?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="${receiptTones.company}">Ph: ${storePhone?xml}</fo:block> </#if> <#if storeEmail?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="${receiptTones.company}">${storeEmail?xml}</fo:block> </#if> <#if taxReg?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="center" color="${receiptTones.company}">GSTIN: ${taxReg?xml}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Header Text --> <#if headerText?has_content> <fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="${receiptOptions.headerAlign}" font-weight="${receiptOptions.headerBold?then('bold','normal')}" color="${receiptTones.header}" space-after="1mm" linefeed-treatment="preserve">${headerText?xml}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Separator --> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1.5mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/>
<#-- Invoice Header --> <fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center" space-after="1mm"><#if ((txn.totalTaxAmount!0)) gt 0>TAX INVOICE<#else>RECEIPT</#if></fo:block> <#if isRevisedBill> <fo:block font-size="8pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center" color="#000" space-after="1mm">EDITED / REVISED BILL</fo:block> </#if>
<#if receiptOptions.showBillNumber || receiptOptions.showDate || (receiptOptions.showCashier && operatorName?has_content) || (showCustomer && (receiptOptions.showCustomerName || (receiptOptions.showCustomerPhone && customerPhone?has_content))) || (showCustomer && customerGstin?has_content)> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="25mm"/><fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/> <fo:table-body> <#if receiptOptions.showBillNumber><fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.information}">${receiptOptions.billNumberLabel?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold">${billNo?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row></#if> <#if receiptOptions.showDate><fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.information}">Date:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${billDate?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row></#if> <#if receiptOptions.showCashier && operatorName?has_content> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.information}">${receiptOptions.cashierLabel?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${operatorName?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#if> <#if showCustomer && receiptOptions.showCustomerName><fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.information}">${receiptOptions.customerLabel?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${customerName?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row></#if> <#if showCustomer && receiptOptions.showCustomerPhone && customerPhone?has_content> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.information}">Mobile:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${customerPhone?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#if> <#if showCustomer && customerGstin?has_content> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.information}">Buyer GSTIN:</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${customerGstin?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#if> </fo:table-body> </fo:table> </#if>
<#-- Separator --> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt solid #000"/>
<#-- Items Table Header --> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(3)"/> <fo:table-column column-width="10mm"/> <fo:table-column column-width="14mm"/> <fo:table-column column-width="16mm"/> <fo:table-header> <fo:table-row background-color="#f0f0f0"> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold">Item</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center">Qty</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">Rate</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">Total</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-header> <fo:table-body> <#list items as item> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.products}">${(item.productName!item.productId!'')?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.products}" text-align="center">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.quantity!0, '#,##0.###'))} ${(unitLabels[item.uomId!'']!'')?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.amounts}" text-align="right">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.unitPrice!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell padding="1pt"><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.amounts}" text-align="right">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.lineTotal!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> <#if ((rTpl.showItemTax)!'N')=='Y' && ((item.totalTaxAmount!0)) gt 0> <fo:table-row><fo:table-cell number-columns-spanned="4"><fo:block font-size="6pt" color="${receiptTones.tax}">Tax: ${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.totalTaxAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#if> <#if showDiscount && ((item.discountAmount!0)) gt 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell number-columns-spanned="4" padding="0pt"> <fo:block font-size="6pt" color="${receiptTones.tax}" margin-left="3mm">Disc: -${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(item.discountAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block> </fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> </#list> </fo:table-body> </fo:table>
<#-- Separator --> <fo:block space-before="1mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/>
<#-- Summary --> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%" space-before="1mm" color="${receiptTones.amounts}"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">Subtotal</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.subtotal!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> <#if showDiscount && ((txn.discountTotal!0)) gt 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.tax}">Discount included</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.discountTotal!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> <#if showTaxBreakdown && ((txn.totalTaxAmount!0)) gt 0> <#if receiptTaxSummary.taxSummary?has_content> <#list receiptTaxSummary.taxSummary as tax> <fo:table-row color="${receiptTones.tax}"><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">${(tax.taxName!'Tax')?xml}</fo:block></fo:table-cell><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(tax.totalTax!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#list> <#else> <fo:table-row color="${receiptTones.tax}"><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt">Tax</fo:block></fo:table-cell><fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.totalTaxAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell></fo:table-row> </#if> </#if> <#if ((txn.roundOff!0)) != 0> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="6pt" color="#000">Round Off</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="6pt" text-align="right" color="#000">${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.roundOff!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </#if> </fo:table-body> </fo:table>
<#-- Grand Total --> <fo:block space-before="1mm" space-after="0.5mm" border-bottom="1pt solid #000"/> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="10pt" font-weight="bold">TOTAL</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="10pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.payableAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-body> </fo:table> <fo:block space-before="0.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="1pt solid #000"/>
<#if showPaymentDetails> <#list receiptPayments as payment><fo:block font-size="7pt" color="${receiptTones.payments}">${(payment.paymentMethod!'')?xml}: ${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(payment.amount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></#list> </#if> <#-- Cash change remains useful without repeating the payment method. --> <#if showPaymentDetails && ((txn.changeAmount!0)) gt 0> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" font-weight="bold">Change</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="7pt" text-align="right" font-weight="bold">${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(txn.changeAmount!0, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-body> </fo:table> </#if>
<#-- Credit / Pay Later marker + amount due (ZE-POS-005) --> <#if isCreditBill> <fo:block space-before="1mm" space-after="0.5mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="center" border="0.5pt solid #000" padding="1mm" space-after="1mm">** <#if creditHasDue>CREDIT / PAY LATER<#else>CREDIT / PAID IN FULL</#if> **</fo:block> <fo:table table-layout="fixed" width="100%"> <fo:table-column column-width="proportional-column-width(1)"/><fo:table-column column-width="24mm"/> <fo:table-body> <fo:table-row> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold">Amount Due</fo:block></fo:table-cell> <fo:table-cell><fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" text-align="right">${cs}${outstandingAmt}</fo:block></fo:table-cell> </fo:table-row> </fo:table-body> </fo:table> </#if>
<#-- Savings --> <#if showDiscount && (totalSaving gt 0)> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="8pt" font-weight="bold" color="${receiptTones.tax}" text-align="center">You Saved: ${cs}${zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(totalSaving, '#,##0.00'))}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Footer --> <#if footerText?has_content> <fo:block space-before="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="6pt" text-align="${receiptOptions.footerAlign}" font-weight="${receiptOptions.footerBold?then('bold','normal')}" color="${receiptTones.footer}" space-before="1mm" linefeed-treatment="preserve">${footerText?xml}</fo:block> </#if>
<#-- Terms --> <#if termsText?has_content> <fo:block space-before="1.5mm" space-after="1mm" border-bottom="0.5pt dashed #000"/> <fo:block font-size="6pt" text-align="${receiptOptions.footerAlign}" color="${receiptTones.footer}" linefeed-treatment="preserve">${termsText?xml}</fo:block> </#if>
<fo:block font-size="9pt" font-weight="bold" color="${receiptTones.footer}" text-align="center" space-before="2mm">Thank You !!</fo:block>
</#if> </fo:flow> </fo:page-sequence> </fo:root>
